source_statements.source_statement: Consume refreshed same-ID packet and current Website/Brand/Product/Architecture/decisions; register source-to-section map, actual surface audit and validated PQC/Definition of Ready before product edits.
Landing EN/HE uses exact selected copy/assets and current structure with specified logistics omissions only; pod/school CTA uses same changeable form; no donation checkout.

/join and /he/join save one durable inquiry with Learning pod / Academy 2027–28 / Both, required email, conditional phone, family area and optional preferred area; out-of-area retained; purpose consent separate from optional unchecked marketing. Stable reference, validation, retry/conflict and unknown-save recovery.
Persist exact EN/HE transactional draft and preview; queue only after save using verified sender, safe name fallback, explicit per-message state, durable dedupe and failure-safe inquiry retention.
Existing ordinary BNA owner view filters program, area and follow-up; detail/notes and email state survive refresh/reopen; wrong-scope and anonymous denial.

Fixed-cutoff BNA-only reversible legacy archive with preflight inventory, backup/restore and repeat-safe migration; preserve history, admin access and new arrivals including inquiries from old contacts; exclude archive from active counts and send selection.

Inspect/fix/recheck desktop 1440×900, mobile 390×844 and relevant Hebrew/RTL; exercise all scoped actions, errors/retry, keyboard/accessibility and owner save/readback. Registries and focused tests pass.
Scoped commit/push/PR and approved deployment path; independently record local, reviewed, deployed, live durable save, ordinary-owner readback and actual email provider evidence.
